analysis.insight_summary: The main usability challenge is the user's struggle to connect the [product_name] app with the related hardware, specifically for managing or viewing digital inputs and outputs through the [product_name] software. The user reports difficultly with configuring tag settings and editing functions, expressing confusion even after reviewing instructions. Inexperience with both the forum and the product environment contributes to the issues.
analysis.user_expectations: User anticipates clear, in-app instructions and documentation that make it easy to configure tags, as well as smooth and intuitive access to digital inputs and outputs for control and monitoring using the [product_name] software and mobile app.
